title: Cu2O@ZIF-8 hybrid catalysts with optimized electronic structures tailored by interfacial interactions for efficient electrocatalytic CO2 reduction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4471-4481
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00721F, Paper
Nouraiz Mushtaq, Agasthiyaraj Lakshmanan, Khizzra Aslam, Alamgir, Qiaohua Qiu, Munir Hussain
Cu2O@ZIF-8 efficiently converts CO2 to CO and CH4 with high faradaic efficiencies (84.7% CO, 78.8% CH4) and stability (20 h). Enhanced by Cu–N/Zn–N sites and sp2 carbon, it outperforms pure ZIF-8, offering a promising MOF-based CO2RR catalyst.
